C1061.title: Five Defendants Sentenced for Plugging Landline Phone Cords into VOIP Devices to Generate Illicit Profit
C1061.summary: In July 2023, Chen A and four others repeatedly stayed in hotels in Xuyong, Sichuan, connected hotel landline phone cords to VIOP voice gateway devices, and maintained the devices under upstream instructions to provide communication lines for a fraud ring. The court found that multiple victims were defrauded and the five defendants obtained illegal proceeds. They were convicted of fraud and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment ranging from two years and ten months to one year and five months, with fines.
